verdict.rationale: HubSpot's core CRM supports contact/company records with associations, dedup, import, and API management, which underpins linked-record management, but the evidence pack lacks direct documentation of the activity timeline UI feature itself (calls, emails, meetings shown chronologically on a record) or hands-on confirmation of the linked-record timeline experience. Missing for 10: explicit documentation/screenshots of the activity timeline feature on contact/company records, independent/hands-on corroboration of the timeline UX, and detail on how associations surface in the timeline view.
